versions.content: The RTE of the transmitting ECU shall perform the conversion of each primitive element, which belongs to the data to be transformed and sent over a communication bus to the representation specified by the baseType and com- puMethod of the ISignal . TransformationISignalProps . DataPrototype- TransformationProps . networkRepresentationProps for the respective primi- tive element. The converted data shall be passed to the first transformer in the chain.
